messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — AcmeEdge (HW partner) told PMs they'd like a joint marketplace listing + press in ~5 weeks. It's embargoed. We need SOC2 report, the latest pen-test artifacts, questionnaire answers, firmware attestation, and HSM/KMS custody proof. Who can own the evidence bundle and sign-off?
maria_s: I can own SOC2 + pen artifacts. Need exact deliverables: SOC2 PDF (redacted), pen-test full report + exec summary (redacted), vuln-scan exports, and remediation timelines. Also need the HSM attestation — is partner providing a vendor attestation PDF or do we require a key ceremony witness?
kevin_si: For SI integration we need ephemeral CI creds, firmware signing fingerprint (sha256), and firmware hash. If partner wants us to verify signing, we need a signed firmware manifest. Also, we previously requested a witness window for the pen test — is that still possible?
sophie_pm: Press embargo lift is 2024-12-12 08:00 PT. To hit that, evidence + owners must be confirmed by 2024-11-28 EOD. Can someone spin up a presigned S3 intake and a short checklist we can hand to AcmeEdge?
alex: @maria_s thanks. I'll confirm witness window and fingerprint with partner. Can you prepare a redaction checklist? Quick template: remove IPs/internal hostnames, redact PII, and include a signed attestation for redactions.
maria_s: Draft checklist coming. High level: 1) Remove IPs/hostnames 2) Replace PII with <REDACTED> 3) Strip raw logs older than 90 days 4) Provide partner-signed redaction attestation. Will post link once presign exists.
kevin_si: Also confirm HSM attestation format: do we accept vendor-signed attestation PDF or require live key ceremony witness? If vendor-signed only, need chain-of-custody doc and KMS ARNs.
alex: Partner prefers presign upload. @deploy-bot can you create a presign folder for acmeedge/marketplace-embargoed/1736001234?
deploy-bot: Created presign bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/acmeedge/marketplace-embargoed/1736001234/ — presign link expires in 7 days. Upload instructions: `aws s3 cp file.pdf s3://redwood-evidence/acmeedge/marketplace-embargoed/1736001234/file.pdf --acl private` — ping alex when done. :white_check_mark:
sophie_pm: Good. Who will be the final approvers for go/no-go? We need a security + product approver on record. Also legal needs to ack the embargo clause after upload.
maria_s: I can be the security approver. I'll also verify redactions and the pen-test exec summary.
sophie_pm: I'll be the product approver. I'll loop in legal via email once artifacts are uploaded.
kevin_si: For SI creds, ask partner to provision an ephemeral service account with limited scope and rotation, then share a one-time secret (we prefer a presign to Secrets Manager export). Also request firmware signing fingerprint and signed manifest.
alex: Summary / next steps:
- Partner uploads artifacts to presign: s3://redwood-evidence/acmeedge/marketplace-embargoed/1736001234/ (deploy-bot created)
- maria_s to draft redaction checklist & upload by EOD tomorrow
- kevin_si to coordinate SI creds & firmware fingerprint with partner
- sophie_pm = product approver, maria_s = security approver, legal ack pending
Deadline: 2024-11-28 23:59 PT (internal target). @acmeedge-contacts please confirm ETA for uploads and whether they can provide vendor attestation PDF for HSM.
maria_s: I'll request the attestation template from partner and push the redaction checklist tomorrow.
alex: Thanks all — keeping updates here. :memo:
